hero.title: Abyssal Escape Roblox
hero.description: Abyssal Escape is a Roblox asymmetric horror game where Survivors must coordinate to dispel an encroaching red mist and escape before things take a turn for the worse. One side plays the Survivors — coordinating, completing objectives and pushing back the mist; the other plays the Killer — a roster of horror icons with distinct phases and abilities hunting them through the dark. Released October 17, 2026 on Roblox by Den_zee's development group, the game already has a passionate community, a wiki ecosystem, killer gameplay videos and a Discord buzzing with sneak peeks. This wiki covers it from launch day: how to play, the killer roster, survivor strategies and every question in between.

aboutGame.title: What Is Abyssal Escape?
paragraphs: Abyssal Escape is an asymmetrical horror game on Roblox, released October 17, 2026, where the classic cat-and-mouse formula gets a specific twist: the Survivors aren't just running — they're dispelling an encroaching red mist that steadily consumes the map, coordinating their efforts to push it back and complete their escape before the mist, or the Killer, ends the round. On the other side, the Killer roster — named horror archetypes like The Maniac and The Furnace — hunts with distinct phases and abilities that the community is already cataloguing kill-by-kill.

The game launched with a wave of community energy: a release-date announcement trailer, killer gameplay videos from Day 1 creators, an active Discord with sneak peeks of upcoming killers, and a wiki ecosystem (including the official abyssalescape.wiki) documenting every phase and ability as it's discovered. Developed under Den_zee's Roblox group (~2,400 members at launch and growing), Abyssal Escape entered the Roblox horror arena at full sprint. This wiki is the fan companion from launch day — both sides' guides, the roster, the strategies and the answers.

items.question: What is Abyssal Escape?
items.answer: A Roblox asymmetric horror game where Survivors coordinate to dispel an encroaching red mist and escape, while a Killer with distinct phases and abilities hunts them. Released October 17, 2026, developed by Den_zee's Roblox group.

items.question: Is Abyssal Escape out?
items.answer: Yes — released October 17, 2026 on Roblox. The game page is live, the Discord is active with sneak peeks, and the killer roster is growing post-launch.

items.question: What is the red mist?
items.answer: The core mechanic: an encroaching mist that steadily consumes the map, pressuring Survivors to coordinate their dispelling efforts while the Killer hunts. It's the clock, the threat and the objective pressure in one system — the tips pages cover its mechanics in depth.

items.question: Who are the killers?
items.answer: A roster of horror archetypes with distinct phases and abilities — The Maniac and The Furnace are the launch-window killers the community has documented, with more teased in the Discord. The killer roster page maps each one's phases as they're catalogued.
